messages:
maria: heads up — dashboard alert: ingest-heartbeat partial acks jumped to ~50% at 10:07 UTC, coincides with preview invoice spikes :grimacing:
aj: ugh, saw the alert. are we losing events or double-acking?
sam: looks like partial acks, not NACKs. consumers are sending an ack-before-fully-processed signal to speed throughput. probably ackstorm on one shard.
maria: if partial acks are counted as delivered by the tallies we might be double charging for tokens. anyone seen invoice preview deltas? :eyes:
jonah: i pulled the preview diff — small but consistent bump for a subset of tenants on routing-2. correlates by route-hint header.
tia: can we sanity-check ingest logs for duplicate fingerprinting? i want to rule out replay vs early-ack artifact.
aj: adding quick grep:
```
# search recent partial acks
grep "partial_ack" /var/log/ingest/* | tail -n 50
```
shows repeated partial_ack events where request_id is same but fingerprint different (kinda weird).
devops-bot: deploy 1765500004 to ingest-proxy-2 succeeded — rolled 10:05 UTC (by aj).
maria: that timing matches. aj, did the proxy change any header behavior?
aj: only sent a small perf tweak — optimistic ack on stream open to reduce tail. i thought it was gated to only local dev canaries. apparently rollout flag to 10% slipped to 50% due to rollout service bug. my bad.
sam: okay so we're likely seeing early-acks from proxy + consumer processing still yielding final events — leads to both early ack counted and final delivery counted in the tallying consumer if we don't dedupe by fingerprint.
tia: quick mitigation: pause the rollout and set proxy optimistic_ack=false. can operations toggle the flag?
jonah: i flipped the rollout gate to 0% at 10:09 UTC. ingest-proxy-2 now at stable config.
maria: awesome. next: reconcile multiplier in preview invoices — we need to identify tenants affected and back out duplicates. who owns the preview pipeline?
aj: that's eng-platform metering. i can export affected tenant ids from route-resolver and pass to billing.
sam: for future-proofing, i propose we change counting contract: only final_deliver events increment invoice counters; early_acks should be marked for telemetry only. that requires a tiny protocol change but would stop this class of blips.
tia: agreed. also add a dashboard card: "early_ack_rate by shard" and an alert if invoice-preview-delta > 0.5% in 5m window.
maria: create a postmortem ticket? even if we roll back, need a short retro and a billing backout plan. tagging @billing to prepare credits for affected tenants.
aj: creating ticket ENGPLAT-9123 and assign to me + sam. i'll attach logs + route list.
devops-bot: ticket ENGPLAT-9123 created by aj — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-9123
jonah: quick note: run a dedupe job on preview pipeline using request_fingerprint with 24h window, should catch the duplicates during rolling window. i'll coordinate with billing for the credits script.
maria: thank you. low-risk rollback in place, keep monitoring for residual partial ack tail. i'll follow up in the ticket with invoice list. :thumbsup:
